model.name: nfl-sim-v1
model.note: Each game is played 10,000 times from 167 completed 2026 box scores: team points from offense and defense ratings, drive by drive, and each player's targets, carries, yards and touchdowns from his recent share of his team's. Players listed out or doubtful sit; questionable players play three draws in four. Win chances, ranges and player means are calibrated on earlier weeks. No market line was used.
